recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not change the extension definition to uri or edit the retained profile artifacts unless a future work-group decision deliberately reverses the long-standing valueUrl representation.
issue_request: FHIR-32105 was Published/Persuasive for R4B/R5 and asked that structuredefinition-fhir-type extension instances in profiles-resources.xml, profiles-types.xml, and profiles-others.xml use valueUrl rather than valueUri. The final resolution reversed an earlier proposal to change the extension definition to uri and instead kept the long-standing url value type.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-32105 was found. The current retained artifacts show the applied state: release4b profile files contain 946 matching fhir-type valueUrl instances and zero valueUri instances, release5 profile files contain 1412 valueUrl and zero valueUri instances, and all tracked core XML contains 3255 valueUrl and zero valueUri instances. History commits cdc3309868ccd5579919ded93d861e90b0701332 and ca6943e1dc3b53a9d1d969ac33358e7cf190009a added retained R4B/R5 profile XML already in the corrected form.
additional_context: The structuredefinition-fhir-type extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and still constrains Extension.value[x] to code url. FHIR-31733 and FHIR-33161 both treat the valueUrl/valueUri point as handled by FHIR-32105 or other trackers, and FHIR-34449 was closed as a duplicate after Zulip discussion confirmed the final FHIR-32105 resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the relevant source/release-history artifacts are already corrected and no tracked core fhir-type instance still uses valueUri.
